method: Four linking strategies (exact email, exact display name, normalized handle equality, handle-as-name-form), plus transitive closure over everything they find. Applied only to attributes the source APIs return on fetched objects. The baseline is given every strategy at once, which is more than a real agent would reliably apply.

modes.aggressive: every strategy, including fuzzy handle-to-name matching
modes.conservative: high-confidence strategies only; declines to guess
